title: fx0: Describe a Page, an Agent Builds It in One HTML File
niche: AI design agents for developers and indie makers

scenes.headline: ONE PROMPT. *A WHOLE PAGE.*
scenes.sub: fx0 · the page was never typed by hand
scenes.say: No designer, no template. This pricing page was written by an agent from one sentence.
You give it a sentence. The agent builds the whole page in the open, then publishes it as one HTML file.

scenes.heading: AND *THIS* ONE TOO
scenes.say: The same agent built this analytics dashboard: visitor numbers, a thirty day chart, and the top pages.

scenes.heading: BEFORE YOU *SHIP IT*
cons: Five free prompts, then sign in
pros: One HTML file, no build step
scenes.say: The honest catch: five free prompts, then you sign in and bill the model to your own account, and the copy is placeholder text you still edit. In return you get one HTML file, no build step, and it is free and open source.
What would you have it build first? Comment Page, and follow for more tools like this.

youtube.description:
fx0 is an open-source design agent from Vercel Labs: describe a page and an agent writes it as a single HTML file, with live publishing and version history. This Short shows a live run that built a pricing page in about ten seconds, plus a dashboard the same agent built. Catches in the video: five free prompts before you sign in and bill your own model, and the copy is placeholder text you still edit.
Source: https://github.com/vercel-labs/fx0
